description: Conflict-first merge instead of last-writer-wins: before a write supersedes an existing record, diff the incoming value against the stored one on fields the writer does not own; on divergence emit a typed conflict and halt rather than overwrite. Targets two live data-loss paths — roadmap generate clobbering hand-authored prose, and the shared build-stream / active-build last-writer-wins race. First slice is the roadmap/prose writer (single-threaded, needs no Umbrella B concurrency primitives). Distinct from COMP-* concurrency work, which prevents the race; this makes the merge honest when the race is already lost. Anchor: docs/features/COMP-CONFLICT-MERGE/plan.md
